name: Wyndham Hotels & Resorts
description: Wyndham licenses its 25 hotel brands (Super 8, Days Inn, Ramada, La Quinta, Baymont, Wyndham and others) to independent owners and does not own the hotels: it is, by its own description, the world's largest hotel franchising company by number of franchised properties, with over 8,300 hotels and about 869,000 rooms in about 100 countries. It earns royalties as a percentage of room revenue (about 38% of 2025 revenue), collects marketing, reservation and loyalty fees that it spends on the brands (about 39%), and sells licensing and other services; the business is mostly economy and midscale hotels in secondary and tertiary US towns (77% of royalties come from the US). Revenue is about $1.4 billion a year with an Adjusted EBITDA of $718 million in 2025, and net income fell to $193 million in 2025 on a $160 million charge tied to the insolvency of a large European franchisee.

businessLines.name: Royalties and franchise fees
businessLines.how: Franchisees pay a percentage of their gross room revenue for the right to use the brand, booking system and loyalty program, so fees move with room count and room revenue per available room (RevPAR), with almost no capital from Wyndham.
businessLines.description: Ongoing royalties on franchisees' room revenue plus initial franchise fees across 25 brands and 8,389 hotels.
businessLines.marketShare: Brands represent about 19% of branded rooms in the United States in the economy, midscale and upper midscale chain scales (FY2025 10-K); no rival shares given

businessLines.name: Marketing, reservation and loyalty fees
businessLines.how: Franchisees pay a percentage of room revenue into a system fund, and Wyndham spends essentially the same amount on marketing, reservations and loyalty rewards, so it adds revenue but little profit.
businessLines.description: Contributions collected from franchisees and spent on brand marketing, the reservation system and the loyalty program.

businessLines.description: Management and other fees (the 10-K sections read do not itemise this line).
